title: Chhota Bheem aur Krishna: Pataliputra - City of the Dead
original_title: छोटा भीम और कृष्ण: पाटलिपुत्र- मृतकों का शहर
overview: The peace of Pataliputra vanishes when Kirmada, the evil starts to hunt people down in order to get his physical form back. When Krishna and Bheem learn that Krimada is finding an opportunity to take revenge on them for destroying his body, they get into swift action to eradicate the scary danger Pataliputra is facing. What will it take for the duo to win?
